# Lucide space symbols

The 48 SVGs embedded in `src/SpaceIcons.cpp` come from official Lucide
release **1.61.0**, published 2026-10-21, pinned to commit
`c29c276f16590cf017126671535ad8c792be64d8`.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/c29c276f16590cf017126671535ad8c792be64d8/icons
Release: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/releases/tag/1.61.0
Usage guide: https://lucide.dev/guide/static

The SVG contents are reproduced verbatim in C++ raw strings. Rendering adds
only the root color and opacity attributes and scales the original 24-pixel
view box. User-facing keys retain the agreed names even where current upstream
SVG filenames differ. No runtime asset files or icon framework are required.

The adjacent **LICENSE** is the full upstream license, including the ISC notice
and the MIT notice for Feather-derived symbols. Preserve both notices when
redistributing these symbols.
